basis: Crop values copied unchanged from the frozen research bucket data/models/water_balance.py (CROPS soy/maize2, Brazil sets, revision 8bb7358) so that the new engine reproduces it under equivalent configuration. fallow.basis: hypothesis: bare/residue soil evaporation, single coefficient, no stage-two drying model

rejected_ids.coffee: ambiguous: choose coffee_arabica or coffee_conilon and a perennial system
rejected_ids.coffee_total_mg: statistical aggregate, not a plantable species
